Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon 2026

Build a Twitch-connected project (API, EventSub, chat, Extensions or overlays) using OpenAI Codex. Top five present live at TwitchCon San Diego on 15 Nov.

PRIZE POOL
$25,000
Reward details
US$25,000 cash: 1st US$10,000, 2nd US$6,000, 3rd US$4,000, two runners-up US$2,500 each.
Submissions close (2 Nov 22:00 UTC)
3 Nov 2026, 03:30 IST
Format & location
Online · Worldwide
Who can apply
Individuals and teams aged 18+ (or age of majority); companies and professional organisations excluded; Brazil, Quebec, Russia, Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and other sanctioned places excluded.
Team size
Check team rules

Entry notes

  • Project must be newly built in the submission period. Needs repo link, public demo video up to 3 min and Codex session ID.
  • AI
  • Codex
  • Twitch
  • Developer tools
